numericalOracle.inputs: Actual mesh.positions and indices of all submitted NEAR static original triangles, local yaw and physical scene sun; not candidate shadow footprint/atlas formulas, no source input from candidate. Three separate turbine families. For native local terrain and actual paired frames use original unchanged N112 uploaded triangle barycentric elevations/rays instead of coarse game collider.
numericalOracle.domain: Local light-plane q=(X−Y*sunX/sunY,Z−Y*sunZ/sunY). Grid in each actual socket from qx −11.977 to 93m, qz −10.961 to 55m, step .18m, non-lattice offset. Native torque is not being measured. Slabs relative mast base Y ∈ {−2.25,−.45,.21,1.65,4.2,9.35,20.2,.51*hub,hub−3.35,hub−.21,hub+1.21,hub+6.1}; not all are ground classes. Also local slope planes [+0.14,-0.07],[-0.11,+0.08], plus mounted N112 heights when available.
numericalOracle.truth: An original triangle intersection along the actual positive sun ray with >0.025m positive height separation is hard blocked. Report continuous geometric top Y/error separately. Raster at all grid centres, not just expected positives. Distance-label core/exterior ≥0.65m from each true isocontour; in addition evaluate every inside/outside border cell without diluting negatives into whole sky. Distinct lower8m tower, middle, and final upper10m/fairing footprint bands, no masking tip or shoulder.
numericalOracle.criteria: Across each near-ground constant slab and each slope, target >=98% core true positives, >=99% exterior true negatives, >=0.92 hard full-silhouette IoU and <=0.65m symmetric p95 contour displacement. Slabs within hub±3.35m or below socket are separate stress controls, not silently aggregated; report exact scores and investigate any above-surface false shaft or major disappeared fairing. No blocked signal above uppermost actual submitted part +.1m (all types). For originally dry terrain beneath rigid scene, credible darkening only, never brighter. Do not claim every static-shadow pixel identical to a true receiver if foot/AA fails bounds.

opticalGate: Three fixed centres at 48% down each actual geometric fall-line for earlier WCW27/EKW6/HCS3, two true opposing low obliques plus high for each. Candidate disabled/current baseline/returned exact; registered whole resident roundtrip. At least two distinct farms with >60 changed RGB samples by >2, none off actual finite ray support beyond bounded atmospheric/AA fringe, no unexplained lightening, no canopy/facade or water changes from loose catcher. Real headings do not change elevation and no new rotor/static shadow until both touch. Permanently protected neighboring structures/road/water/features; if physically opaque mesh receives natural authored shadow and overlays unchanged, state actual receiver instead of broader claim.
stopping: If material sampler, physically safe bounds, geographic admission, cheap fallback or shape authenticity fail, hold separately from unchanged 74 real models; do not fit beyond thresholds on test labels.
